messages.content: What is the freezing point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure, provided in kilopascals (kPa) or atmospheres (atm). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 bar), pure water freezes at roughly **–2.2 °C**.  

This value comes from the water phase diagram: the freezing (melting) line slopes downward with decreasing pressure, and at 10 kPa the equilibrium temperature is about –2 °C.  (The exact value depends slightly on the purity of the water and the method used to determine the phase boundary, but –2.2 °C is the accepted figure for standard laboratory conditions.)
